audit_notes: Table 2 has nine VQA model-dataset combinations; each best-performing configuration includes relation labels, contrary to §5 claim that textual IDs without relation labels generally achieve top performance.
Figure 4 Gemma/GQA visual+text bar is lower than visual-only, contrary to §5 claim that combining modalities always produces gains.
Gemma VQAv2 raw 59.9 to 71.9 is +12.0 percentage points; abstract says up to 11 percentage points.

RefCOCOg threshold is IoU>=0.9. Table 2 omits raw/segmentation-only results because ID-output setup does not apply; Figure 4 nevertheless shows corresponding raw-image bar without explaining a comparable protocol.
27 decoding conditions combine seed, temperature and top-p; reported standard deviation is across these settings, not independent dataset bootstrap confidence intervals.
Algorithm settings selected using preliminary Qwen-2.5-VL runs on GQA; validation/test separation of that selection is not specified.
Visual SG only still includes textual object names and relation labels rendered into pixels; it is not a language-free spatial-reasoning condition.
Scene graph construction introduces detector labels, depth estimates, relation rules and query filtering; existing experiments do not isolate a pure equal-information format intervention.
No temporal identity consistency or real robot execution experiment; stable IDs across frames in reading are explicitly an engineering extension.

Appendix Algorithm 3 fallback retains objects but does not explicitly restore all relations, whereas main text states both should be retained. Directional sign versus head-tail tuple convention requires implementation unit tests.

Current repository README names Depth Anything V2, YOLOv8-only defaults and WBF IoU 0.55; paper uses MiDaS, a three-detector ensemble and overlap threshold 0.9. Do not reproduce Table 2 with current defaults without configuration verification.

Author-provided AAAI manuscript and arXiv v2 differ mainly in related-work descriptions/citations, reference fixes, symbols and appendix numbering; key methods and Table 2/Figures 3–4 match on inspection.
